detailed_descriptions.en: Take over a crumbling, haunted café and transform it into a sanctuary for monstrous guests. Restore, decorate, and expand while brewing strange coffees, stocking supplies, and keeping hostile anomalies at bay. My Little Cafe Nightmare is a dark yet cozy first-person café sim where every cup matters. RENOVATE & CUSTOMIZE YOUR CAFE Breathe new life into a forgotten café. Repair the rot, decorate with care, and expand your space to create a warm refuge for wandering creatures of the night. BREW OTHERWORLDLY COFFEE Craft hauntingly good drinks with unique flavours to satisfy the peculiar cravings of your ghostly visitors. Each guest has their own taste, and only the right brew will earn their trust. MANAGE YOUR LOGISTICS Manage ingredients, cups, and equipment carefully. Order supplies, keep your storage tidy, and make sure your café can withstand the endless demand of spectral customers.
